description: EN/TR Common Semantic IR records used as the language-adapter regression baseline (#3476). The cases were first frozen from the L1 baseline (#3312) before the L2 adapters existed; the English-copula cases were refreshed once, deliberately, when #3643 taught the predicate parser to read "X is/are Y" as a type relation instead of leaving "are animals" as an özellik node. The L2 adapters must leave every case byte-identical.
